pinned_basis.what: the same coefficients through two stores that agree to 1e-10; any deviation here is the BASIS, not the deletion

svd_basis.what: the same coefficients through two stores that agree to 1e-10; any deviation here is the BASIS, not the deletion

what: ⛔ Two stores that agree to 1e-10 are handed IDENTICAL coefficients. Under gen_read.span_basis the rendered vectors differ by O(1), because that basis is the SVD of an atom block whose spectrum is maximally degenerate (r unit rows), so a 1e-10 atom perturbation rotates it by O(1). Under pinned_span_basis -- the store's own already-orthonormal rows, no SVD -- they do not. ⭐ The deletion is exact either way; what the pinned basis buys is that the READ survives it.
